text:
noah: Quick sync from the postmortem follow-up: we need final statuspage language + a clear RCA sharing flow. Legal flagged potential PII in internal traces. Can we assign owners for (1) public status wording, (2) customer-facing summary, (3) full-RCA access process and consent?

tara: I can take the statuspage text. I'll post a draft this afternoon.

amna: I'll own the customer-facing summary + email template. Thinking: short timeline, impact, what we fixed, and planned prevention work. For full RCA, propose 'available on request to enterprise customers with a signed consent form / NDA' so we don't leak raw logs.

raj: Agreed on request-only full RCA. Also note we have a recurring pattern: cache eviction-related spikes in 4 incidents across two months. Need a remediation ticket and detection alert. I'm happy to own the remediation.

legal-bot: Legal note: avoid IPs, query text, and raw stack traces in public materials. Use sanitized examples only. Use phrase 'technical summary' (legal preferred).

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-2026-099 023-11-05 08:12 UTC 0assigned to @noah

noah: Tara, paste status copy here when ready. Amna, target for customer email by Tue EOD? Raj, please open remediation ticket with acceptance criteria and attach detection rule.

tara: Draft statuspage copy: 
```
Status: Partial degradation of generation API.
Impact: elevated latency and 5xxs affecting ~10% of requests from 07:1007:40 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated 0we rolled back the last deploy and are monitoring.
Next steps: A technical summary will be posted and a customer-facing summary will be shared by <date>.
```
Any phrasing tweaks?

amna: Suggest adding: "Data integrity: no customer data was altered or lost." Also add contact link to support and a short 'What we're doing to prevent this' blurb.

noah: Good. Locking policy proposal: public technical summary on status page + offer full internal RCA to affected enterprise customers on request. Require CSM confirmation + consent form/NDA for any internal logs or traces. Owner: amna to draft consent/roadmap for RCA access (due Tue EOD). Owner: raj for remediation ticket (ETA 2 sprints). Owner: tara for statuspage text (due today).

raj: Created ticket INF-4392 "cache-eviction: guardrails + detection". Owner: raj, ETA two sprints, acceptance criteria added. Will add a Grafana alert rule to detect repeated eviction patterns.

amna: I'll post the customer email template and a short consent checkbox copy here by Tue EOD.

noah: Let's do an async review tomorrow 10:30am PT. If drafts look ok I'll send to Legal for final sign-off. Final action list I'm tracking: - Statuspage wording (owner: tara) - Customer summary + email template (owner: amna) - Consent & RCA access process (owner: amna, legal consult) - Remediation ticket + detection (owner: raj) - Proactive outreach list for top affected customers (owner: cs-team)

tara: ack :thumbsup:

amna: ack, will post drafts.

noah: Thanks all. I'll update the incident board with owners and ETA. If Legal has edits, @legal-bot please ping here.
